I'm watching $CELR for one thing: whether sellers can actually keep price below the trigger.

The evidence is aligned enough to test $CELR, but the level still has to break or hold before the setup is valid.

No confirmation, no thesis. If price reclaims the invalidation level, I'm done with the setup.

Entry trigger: 0.003136714. TP1: 0.001747678. TP2: 0.000358642. SL / invalidation: 0.00452575.

There is no need to force it; a clean invalidation keeps the call honest.

What would make you reject the SHORT thesis around 0.003136714?

Scenario to test, not certainty.
